title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
author: Anthropic
description: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.
summary: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects. You can submit a proposal for a project here .
takeaways: Over 8–12 weeks, guest investigators will work directly with Anthropic researchers on a problem of interest and produce the analyses, artifacts, and tools that will be most helpful for them in their work.
Our team will run our models and harnesses at no cost to them.
We’re looking for applicants who can clearly explain how they would benefit from direct collaboration with Anthropic’s researchers.
